mapper.sql: id, municipality_id as municipalityId, collection_date, sector, collection_type, bin_color, note_fr, note_en, note_zh, source_url
mapper.select: select from collection_event where municipality_id = #{municipalityId} order by collection_date desc, collection_type asc

select from collection_event where municipality_id = #{municipalityId} order by case when collection_date >= #{today} then 0 else 1 end, case when collection_date >= #{today} then collection_date end asc, collection_date desc, collection_type asc, id asc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from collection_event where municipality_id = #{municipalityId}
mapper.insert: insert into collection_event (municipality_id, collection_date, sector, collection_type, bin_color, note_fr, note_en, note_zh, source_url) values (#{municipalityId}, #{collectionDate}, #{sector}, #{collectionType}, #{binColor}, #{noteFr}, #{noteEn}, #{noteZh}, #{sourceUrl})

insert into collection_event (municipality_id, collection_date, sector, collection_type, bin_color, note_fr, note_en, note_zh, source_url, auto_generated) values
(#{event.municipalityId}, #{event.collectionDate}, #{event.sector}, #{event.collectionType}, #{event.binColor}, #{event.noteFr}, #{event.noteEn}, #{event.noteZh}, #{event.sourceUrl}, true)
on conflict on constraint uq_collection_event do nothing
mapper.update: update collection_event set collection_date = #{collectionDate}, sector = #{sector}, collection_type = #{collectionType}, bin_color = #{binColor}, note_fr = #{noteFr}, note_en = #{noteEn}, note_zh = #{noteZh}, source_url = #{sourceUrl} where id = #{id}
